text_block_list.text:
Running with everything she had so as not 
to be overwhelmed by her rival's fearsome 
drive, Winning Ticket claimed victory over 
Narita Taishin.

Winning Ticket responds to all-out effort 
with all-out effort. Though she didn't put 
it into words, Narita Taishin seemed to 
acknowledge her for it.

And Narita Taishin declared that she 
absolutely would not lose at the Satsuki 
Sho.

Days of devoted training begin so she 
won't lose in her next race either.
